title: ApproveResult
description: 200 body of POST /api/proposals/:id/approve (docs/04 §2.1). `deploys` is deploysOnCommit(paths) from netlify/functions/lib/deploys.mts over the committed paths, and is required so the outcome copy never guesses (Deploying… + Live vs No deploy needed). `approvals` is read after recording; null if that read fails. A 200 can carry status `committing` when the commit landed but recording did not finish (docs/04 §1, §7 reconciler).
